names.ream_house_1901_prairie: 1901 Prairie Avenue — Norman B. Ream house

source.citation: 'Residence of Mr. N. B. Ream, 1901 Prairie Avenue.' Halftone plate, photographer uncredited, sharing a page with 'Residence of Dr. H. S. Brown, 4917 Drexel Boulevard'. Rand, McNally & Co.'s Pictorial Chicago (Chicago: Rand, McNally & Co., 1893). Reprinted from the same negative in the 1896 edition.
what_it_does_not_supply: colour: the plate is a monochrome halftone
the north flank, the rear and the brick rear range
any independent view: the 1896 reprint is the same negative
what_it_supplies: a date for the photograph the chicagology copy reproduces: by 1893
the street front's composition, as the 1898 copy does, at slightly better resolution
the stoop's two cheeks pierced by a row of openings under their tops
